newsitem.title: USA: PAINEWEBBER STOCK BUYBACK COSTS $219 MLN.
newsitem.headline: PAINEWEBBER STOCK BUYBACK COSTS $219 MLN.

text.p: PaineWebber Group Inc said Thursday that it would pay $36.50 a share or $219 million for the six million shares it agreed to buy back from GE Capital Services, a General Electric Co unit.
PaineWebber disclosed the price of the deal in a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
Earlier, PaineWebber and GE announced the deal, in which the GE unit would sell back common stock it acquired in connection with the 1994 sale of brokerage Kidder Peabody to PaineWebber.
The deal would cut GE's stake in PaineWebber to 23 percent on a diluted basis, or 15.5 million shares. GE said it would continue to be represented on the PaineWebber board after the sale.
The transaction is subject to regulatory approval.
